To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• Typeface style, color, weight and depth affect the visibility of text in an indoor mobile AR environment.
• The typeface style, the color and the depth of a 3D typography has an impact on the readability of the text.

the design of typography in 3D for indoor AR applications can have an effect on the visibility of the typography, and the design attributes of typeface style and color, as well as weight including depth, should be taken into consideration when designing typography for indoor AR applications.

how to use typography in three dimensions in mobile Augmented Reality applications for indoor usage.
how typography can be used to communicate information in Augmented Reality (Augmented Reality) applications.
the design and use of three dimensional typography for indoor mobile augmented reality (AR) applications.

The main takeaway from our work is that
3D typography can be used in indoor AR mobile applications, but that the typeface should be sans serif, and the color of the type should be bright and the weight should be bold.
the design guidelines for 3D typography in AR should be based on a combination of color, weight and typeface style.
3D typography is a powerful tool for communicating information through augmented reality.
